description: This file defines a C# class 'CatalogItemOrdered' representing a snapshot of ordered catalog items, ensuring immutability of order details.

classes.name: CatalogItemOrdered
classes.description: A value object that captures the details of a catalog item at the time of ordering, to preserve order integrity despite catalog changes.

methods.name: CatalogItemOrdered (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CatalogItemOrdered with specified item ID, product name, and picture URI, with validation.

methods.name: CatalogItemOrdered (private parameterless constructor)
methods.description: Required for Entity Framework to materialize objects from the database.
